newsitem.title: USA: American Express to exchange debt.
newsitem.headline: American Express to exchange debt.

text.p: American Express Co said on Monday it will exchange its DECS (debt exchangeable for common stock) that matures October 15, 1996, for First Data Corp common stock.

American Express presently holds 22,618,500 shares of First Data, an information processor and processor of credit card transactions, and would issue over 19 million shares of FDC to DECS holders, American Express spokeswoman Susan Miller said.
American Express has 23,618,500 DECS in the form of 6.25 percent exchangeable notes that were issued in a principal amount of $36.75 per DECS.
At maturity, holders of DECS will receive a number of First Data shares based on the average closing price of First Data during the 20-day trading period from September 16 through October 11, 1996.
If the share price of First Data stayed above 44-7/8, then each DECS holder would get 0.819 shares of FDC per DECS. First Data shares traded at 77, unchanged, on 190,500 shares of volume.
After the exchange, American Express's stake in First Data would fall to 3.3 million shares, Miller said.
In April 1992, American Express held an initial public offering of First Data in April 1992 and a secondary offering in March 1993, Miller said.
The DECS were issued in October 15, 1993, American Express said.
